steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: You should expect the warriors to have taken some aspect of these diamonds as their own...

steps.player: Do you have any idea how I could track down these warriors somehow, then?

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: There is an ancient spell I know of that may spy upon such power... But it will require a few ingredients for it to work.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Should you be willing to get these ingredients for me, I will be able to locate the rough area where each of these warriors has taken refuge. The spell is imprecise, but it should help you get on the

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: right track in your search.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Is your desire for our freedom strong enough? Will you gather the ingredients for this spell for me?

steps.player: Sure, what do you need?

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: For this spell, I will need to make some scrying glasses. I will need enough so that we can view the realm in its entirety.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: When enchanted, the scrying glass will be able to let us view any area that has been influenced by the presence of the Diamonds of Azzanadra.

steps.player: Okay, but what exactly do you need for this spell?

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Well, six scrying glasses should be sufficient. For each scrying glass, I will need two magic logs, a steel bar and some molten glass. This makes a total of 12 magic logs, 6 pieces of molten

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: glass, and 6 steel bars.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: In addition, for the actual spell to enchant the glasses, I will require one set of normal bones, some ash, some charcoal and a single blood rune.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Do you understand me, adventurer?

steps.player: Quick question; what kind of bones do you need?

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Standard bones. Other types of bones are of no use to me in this spell.

options.text: Yes, I will go get those for you.

steps.player: It's a slightly odd collection of ingredients, but I shouldn't have too much trouble getting those for you.

steps.text: Same as "Talking to Eblis after agreeing to get ingredients" below.

steps.player: Actually I don't feel like going on a shopping trip for you right now.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: As you wish. I should have known not to get my hopes up that our long cursed life may soon be at an end...

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: can't be any more help than that.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.player: I don't understand why there are six mirrors when there are only four diamonds...

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: As I say, the enchantment is very inaccurate.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: I can only focus upon the aura the diamonds have left behind them, so any place where the Diamonds were present for a significant period of time will still be shown - such as the Bandit Camp where I make my home.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: My apologies, but magic is an inaccurate art in many respects.

enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.speaker: Eblis
enchanting-the-mirrors-talking-to-eblis-.text: Don't forget to come back here when you have collected all four diamonds.

shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo.speaker: Rasolo
shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo.text: Greetings friend. I am Rasolo, the famous merchant. Would you care to see my wares?

options.text: Ask about the Diamonds of Azzanadra

steps.player: No, actually I was looking for something specific...

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Hmmmm? And what would that be?

steps.player: I am looking for one of the Diamonds of Azzanadra. I have reason to believe it may be somewhere around here...

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Ahhh...  The Shadow Diamond...

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: I know the object of which you speak. It is guarded by a fearsome warrior known as Damis, they say, who lives in the shadows, invisible to prying eyes...

steps.player: How can I find this 'Damis' then?

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Well now... perhaps we can help each other out here.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: I have in my possession a small trinket, a ring, that allows its wearer to see the unseen...

steps.player: How much do you want for it?

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Ah, but it is not for sale...  As such...

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: I am offering to trade it for an item that was rightfully mine, but that was stolen by a bandit named Laheeb.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: The item in question is a gilded cross, that has some sentimental value to myself. I wish for you to recover this item for me, and I will happily let you have my ring of visibility.

steps.player: Where can I find this Laheeb?

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Well, as a travelling merchant I have roamed these lands for many years...

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: To the far east of here there is an area that is dry, and barren like the desert... it is called...

steps.player: Al Kharid?

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: ...Yes, Al Kharid. Now, to the south of Al Kharid there is a passageway, it is called the...

steps.player: Shantay Pass.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: ...Yes. I didn't realise you had travelled there yourself.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Anyway, when you have gone through the Shantay Pass, you will find yourself in a hostile desert... You will need to bring water with you to keep your life. Now, to the south-west of this pass, you will find a small

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: village...

steps.player: The Bedabin camp.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: If you know where Laheeb lives, why did you ask me?

steps.player: I don't. Sorry, please continue.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: Well, okay then. Anyway, south of this encampment there is an area where few have ever been... It is a village of murderous bandits, and treacherous

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: thieves... This is where Laheeb makes his home.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: He will have hidden his stolen treasure somewhere in that village, I am sure of it. When you find his loot, you will find my gilded cross. Return it to me, and I will reward you with my ring

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: of visibility, so that you may find Damis. Does this seem fair to you?

steps.player: Not a problem. I'll be back with your cross before you know it.
Sounds like too much effort to me. I'll find this Damis by myself.

steps.speaker: Rasolo
steps.text: As you wish.

shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-after-d.speaker: Rasolo

shadow-diamond-talking-to-rasolo-after-d.text: Well now... perhaps we can help each other out here.

steps.text: Hmm? You know very well that your tithe is due, Roavar. I am here to collect.

steps.text: Y-yes of course, sire, but surely your graciousness is too important to perform such menial duties? Is this not Gadderanks job, your most high beneficence?

steps.text: Indeed it is Roavar, but I cannot find that incompetent fool. And assuming you are not the one who wishes to tell Lord Drakan that his tithe has not been collected, I saw fit to take on the duty myself this time.

steps.text: Of course, my lord, I meant no disrespect.

blood-diamond-entering-the-hair-of-the-d.text: Yes, you. Your bearing suggests you are not one of the usual peasants, and your stench suggests you are not one of these filthy wolfen folk.

blood-diamond-entering-the-hair-of-the-d.text: Come here, I would like to know what you are doing here.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak.text: If the player is wearing a Ring of Charos(a):

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: A human, eh? Don't think that silly little ring of yours will fool me. Give me one good reason why I should not just take you to Lord Drakan now.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: A human, eh? Don't think that silly little ring of yours will fool me. Give me one good reason why I should not just kill you right now.

options.text: I am here to worship Zamorak

steps.player: I am here to worship the almighty Zamorak! Yay! Go Zamorak!

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I see. You are a moron. You have probably settled right in with the rest of the idiots in this pathetic excuse for a village.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Unfortunately for you, that is not a good enough reason to explain your presence here.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Now tell me the reason for your coming here, or I will ensure you suffer a horrible fate indeed.

options.text: Well, I could tell Sugadinti about you collecting tithes...

steps.text: Hah! Most entertaining, human! Lord Sugadinti does not have time for a human like you. Besides, Roavar owes me a personal debt, and I do not intend any new laws to stop me from collecting it.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Now, tell me the reason you are here.

options.text: I am here to praise Lord Drakan

steps.player: I am here only to serve the mighty Drakan. Yup, Drakan, he's the man.

steps.text: If the player has completed Vampyre Slayer:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I see. I would perhaps be more inclined to believe you if I could not smell the death blood of his brother Draynor upon you.

steps.text: What are you real intentions here?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Really? That is interesting, that you would want to give your life by tresspassing in this land for such an unbelievable reason.

options.text: I am here to worship you, oh mighty Malak

steps.text: Please. Do not think that I am so vain and foolish as to allow you to avoid my question with such obvious sycophancy.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Now tell me the reason behind your being here, or I will ensure that you suffer.

options.text: I am here to kill Lord Drakan

steps.player: I am here to kill Lord Drakan, and every stinking one of his vampyre brood!

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Hah! Most entertaining, human!

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Now tell me the reason you are here, or we shall soon see who will be killing whom.

options.text: I am looking for a special Diamond...

steps.player: I am here looking for a special diamond... I have reason to believe it is somewhere in this vicinity, and it is probably in the possession of a warrior of Zamorak.
I'm fairly sure it will have some kind of magical aura or something too. I don't suppose you've seen it, or know where it might be?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Interesting... Well perhaps we can come to a little... arrangement, human.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I may have information that may assist you, but you in turn will have to do something for me. What do you say? Do you think we could come to some form of

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: agreement?

steps.player: Well, what kind of something? No offence, but you're not exactly the trustworthy type...

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Ah, you have a healthy sense of paranoia, I see. It is not a particularly unfair request on my part...

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: All I ask is that you ensure that the current owner of the diamond is killed. For my part, I will let you know his whereabouts, and how exactly to kill him.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: When he is dead, you may take the diamond from his corpse and do with it what you will. I have no interest in such baubles.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: So what say you? A life for a diamond. As a mark of good faith, I will give you some information free:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: The current owner of this diamond is named Dessous.

steps.player: Well... I can't see any drawback. Okay, I accept your offer. Now tell me what you know.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: What I know? Hah! After you have been alive for as long as I, the things I know are enough to fill a library.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I'm afraid you will need to be a little more specific.

options.text: Why do you want Dessous dead?

steps.player: I don't see exactly how this bargain benefits you... Why exactly do you want Dessous killed anyway?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: That is an impertinent question to demand from myself.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: However, if it will help seal our deal, I will let you know some of the details.
If the player has not completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: As you may or may not know, myself and my blood kin are the rulers of this land, all serving under Lord Drakan. However, we tend not to die of old age or similar

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: natural causes, which means that to gain another Lords tithe or land, there often need to be...
If the player has completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: While there may have been some changes to things around here recently, myself and my blood kin are still the rulers of this land. However, we tend not to die of old age or similar

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: natural causes, which means that to gain another Lords title or land, there often need to be...

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Unnatural causes of death involved. Let us just say, that Dessous is in control of some land that I myself would like some say in, and that it is not in my interest to be seen to be responsible for the

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: death of a fellow Lord.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: It would however be extremely advantageous to myself should some random human adventurer take it upon themself to remove this rival for me... Do you understand?

steps.player: Yes... I think so...

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Good, we understand each other then. We will both benefit from the death of Dessous.

steps.player: Where can I find this Dessous?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: He currently resides in a graveyard to the South-East of here. You will not be able to move the gravestone which he lies beneath however, you will need to find some way to

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: lure him out from his tomb.

steps.player: And how exactly would I go about doing that?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Well, he is a vampyre, so fresh blood would almost certainly entice him out.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: However, even though he is a frail and decrepit example of our species, he will be able to kill a weakling human such as yourself extremely easily. Having him in a bloodlust as he does so, will not make

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: your job any easier.

steps.player: So what advice can you give me on killing Dessous?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: As ancient and weak as Dessous is, he is still more than a match for the likes of you.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: That is, assuming you were to fight him fairly.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: My proposal would be for you to even the odds up a little bit...

steps.player: How would I go about doing that?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Well, my plan would be as follows. First, take a silver bar to the man living in the sewers in Draynor. He was an assistant to Count Draynor in some of his...

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: more interesting experiments many years past. Tell him you need a sacrificial offering pot. He will know what you speak of, it is a unique type of container used in various ancient vampyric ceremonies.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Then take the pot to Entrana and get it blessed by the Head Monk. This will lend the pot some holy power.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: If you then bring that silver pot back to me, I will provide you with some fresh blood, to put into it. To that pot of blood, you will add some crushed garlic, and some spice to disguise the smell.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Use that pot of blood upon Dessous' tomb, and he will be unable to resist rising and drinking from it.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: The combination of garlic, silver, and blessings from Saradomin will act upon him as a poison, and allow you to kill him.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: This is just my suggestion of course, you may ignore it if you wish, although I offer no guarantees of your ability to defeat him otherwise.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Was there anything else you wanted?

options.text: Actually, I don't need to know anything.

steps.player: Never mind, I will figure out all I need to know by myself.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: As you wish. Come and see me when you have managed to kill Dessous.

steps.player: I don't trust you, or anything you say. I'm afraid I have to decline.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: As you wish human. I doubt anybody near here knows of the diamond you seek, however.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: If you wish to claim it as your own, you have little choice but to accept my bargain. I will wait here until such time as you change your mind.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-agr.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-agr.text: Why are you still here? I notice Dessous still lives.

steps.player: Where can I find this Dessous?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: He currently resides in a graveyard to the South-East of here. You will not be able to move the gravestone which he lies beneath however, you will need to find some way to

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: lure him out from his tomb.

steps.player: And how exactly would I go about doing that?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Come and see my when you have prepared a silver ritual pot in the manner I have told you.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I will ensure that you get some fresh blood that you may taint with garlic and spices, to lure our Dessous.

options.text: How do I kill Dessous again?

steps.player: How am I supposed to kill Dessous again?

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Take a silver bar to the man in the Draynor sewers. He will fashion a ritualistic pot for you, which you should then take to Entrana and get blessed.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: When you have done that, come back here and speak to me, I will provide you with some fresh blood which you will then crush some garlic into, and then add some spices to hide the garlic.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: In this way, you will be able to lure him from his tomb and he should be sufficiently weakened to be vulnerable to your attacks.

options.text: Actually, I don't need to know anything.

blood-diamond-talking-to-ruantun.speaker: Ruantun
blood-diamond-talking-to-ruantun.text: You ssshould not be down here...

blood-diamond-talking-to-ruantun.player: Are you an assistant to Count Draynor?

blood-diamond-talking-to-ruantun.speaker: Ruantun
blood-diamond-talking-to-ruantun.text: I usssed to have that honour... Why do you ssseek me?
If the player has a silver bar.

steps.player: I have a silver bar with me, I was wondering if you could make it into a 'sacrificial offering pot' for me?

steps.speaker: Ruantun
steps.text: Yesss, of courssse... There you are, put it to good usssse...

blood-diamond-talking-to-ruantun.text: If the player doesn't have a silver bar.

steps.player: I understand that you can make me a 'sacrificial offering pot' if I bring you a bar of silver?

steps.speaker: Ruantun
steps.text: And where did you hear thisss?

steps.player: It was from Malak in Canifis.

steps.speaker: Ruantun
steps.text: Ah, I sssee... Yesss, I know how to make sssuch an item... It has been many yearsss sssince I have needed to however...

steps.speaker: Ruantun
steps.text: It is not my wisssh to quessstion your desssire for sssuch an item. I wasss merely sssurprisssed that one sssuch as you would make sssuch a requessst...

steps.speaker: Ruantun
steps.text: I will happily make you thisss pot, but you mussst bring me a bar of sssilver... Alasss, I can no longer collect my own ingredientsss, and mussst remain here...

blood-diamond-using-items-on-him.speaker: Ruantun
blood-diamond-using-items-on-him.text: I have no ussse for that...

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.speaker: High Priest
blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.text: Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.player: Hi, I was wondering, can you quickly bless this for me?

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.speaker: High Priest
blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.text: A somewhat strange request, but I see no harm in it. There you go. May Saradomin walk with you.

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.speaker: High Priest
blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.text: Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.player: Hi, I was wondering, can you quickly bless this for me?

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.speaker: High Priest
blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.text: A somewhat strange request, but I see no harm in... Wait a moment... is that BLOOD?

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.speaker: High Priest
blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.text: Why do you want me to bless a pot full of someones blood???

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.player: Oh, don't worry, it's not 'someones', it's my own!

blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.speaker: High Priest
blood-diamond-talking-to-the-high-priest.text: I... see... Well it is an unusual thing, but I see no harm in it. Take this, and walk in peace with Saradomin.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-with-the-.player: I found Ruantun in Draynors sewers. He made me this pot, now where can I get some fresh blood to fill it with?

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-with-the-.text: Malak cuts you and pours some of your blood into the pot.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-with-the-.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-with-the-.text: There you go. As fresh as it gets.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-with-the-.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-with-the-.text: Come and speak to me again when you have managed to kill Dessous.

blood-diamond-adding-garlic-to-the-bless.text: You add some crushed garlic to the pot.

blood-diamond-adding-spices-to-the-bless.text: You add some spices to the pot.

blood-diamond-using-the-blessed-pot-on-d.text: You pour the blood from the pot onto the tomb.

blood-diamond-using-an-empty-blessed-pot.text: There is nothing in the pot to pour onto the grave.

blood-diamond-after-defeating-dessous.player: Well that's Dessous dead, but where is the Diamond he was supposed to have?
If Malak lied to me about it, he is going to pay!

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.text: Ah, the wandering hero returns! I take it you have dispatched poor old Dessous for me?

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.player: Quit playing games with me, Malak. I want that diamond, and I want it now!

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.text: Do not take that tone of voice with me, meat. You should be thankful I have allowed you your life.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.text: Here, take your precious little bauble.
If the player has not completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I will take that silver pot from you as well, humans are not meant to possess such artefacts. Now get out of my sight, our deal is complete, and if I see you here again I will not hesitate to take you to

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: Lord Drakan.

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: He will be extremely pleased to meet the murderer of poor Dessous, I suspect.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-def.text: If the player has completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: I will take that silver pot from you as well, humans are not meant to possess such artefacts. Now get out of my sight, our deal is complete, and if I see you here again I will not hesitate to put an end to

steps.speaker: Malak
steps.text: you.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-obt.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-obt.text: Be lucky I have let you live, meat. Our deal is done, I wish no further dealing with you.

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-los.player: Where is the Diamond of Blood? I know you have it!

blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-los.speaker: Malak
blood-diamond-talking-to-malak-after-los.text: Do not take that tone of voice with me, meat. Here, take your bauble. I have no use for it.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child.text: This troll seems very upset about something. Maybe some sweet food would take his mind off things?

ice-diamond-attempting-to-go-through-the.text: The bars are frozen tightly shut and a sturdy layer of ice prevents you from slipping through.

ice-diamond-giving-the-troll-child-an-it.text: It doesn't look like that will cheer him up at all...

ice-diamond-giving-the-troll-child-sweet.player: Hey there little troll... Take this and dry those tears...

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: It was the bad man! He hurt my mommy and daddy! He made them all freezey!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: He said it was because they stole his diamond! But they never did! They found it, and didn't know who it belonged to!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: My mommy always told me stealing is wrong, they would never steal from someone!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: Then he did some wavey hand thing and my mommy and daddy got frozified!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.player: A diamond you say? Listen, I think I might be able to help your parents, but I need that Diamond in return.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: -sniff- I don't think they really wanted it anyway, they would have given it back to the bad man if he'd asked before freezifying them...

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: I give you my promise, that if you unfreeze my mommy and daddy, you can have the stupid diamond.

steps.player: Absolutely. Don't worry kid, I'll get your parents back to you safe and sound.
Sorry, I can't make any promises about that, and I don't think I have the time to waste trying to defrost some stupid ice trolls.

steps.speaker: Troll child
steps.text: Waaaaaaa!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: You didn't free my mommy and daddy yet?

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: Please try harder! I love my mommy and daddy!

ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate-for-th.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate-for-th.text: Oh, I'm sorry. My mommy says that we ice trolls are so cold we can freeze the air around us when we are upset or angry.

ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate-for-th.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate-for-th.text: I'm afraid I must have frozen those gates too much when I was crying, but since you told me you are going to help rescue my mommy and daddy you should be able to squeeze through the bars.

ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate-for-th.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate-for-th.text: You are much smaller than most trolls, it should be easy for you!

ice-diamond-entering-the-ice-gate.text: You squeeze through the large icy bars of the gate.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-ice-troll-pas.speaker: Ice troll
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-ice-troll-pas.text: Hur hur hur! Well look here, a puny fleshy human!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-ice-troll-pas.speaker: Ice troll
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-ice-troll-pas.text: You should beware of the icy wind that runs through this valley, it will bring a fleshy like you to a cold end indeed!

ice-diamond-trying-to-enter-the-cave.text: The entrance to the cave is covered in too much ice to get through.

ice-diamond-killing-an-ice-troll.text: A chunk of ice falls away from the cave entrance.

ice-diamond-after-defeating-kamil.player: Well, that must have been the 'bad man' that the troll kid was on about... His parents must be up ahead somewhere.

ice-diamond-trying-to-climb-the-ice-ledg.player: I don't think I'll make much headway along that icy slope without some spiked boots...

ice-diamond-passing-through-the-ice-gate.text: You Squeeze through the large icy bars of the gate.

ice-diamond-talking-to-a-frozen-troll.text: There is a thick layer of ice covering this troll. You will have to find some way of shattering it.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-father-.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-father-.text: Oh thank you! It was really cold in there! But please, you must free my wife as well! Our son is depending on us!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-mother-.speaker: Troll mother
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-mother-.text: Wow, thanks for breaking me out of that ice! But please, my husband is still trapped in there!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Phew! Am I glad to be out of that big ice cube! Are you okay too darling?

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll mother
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Yes, I thought we were done for! Why ever did that nasty Kamil freeze us up there anyway?

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.player: He must have been trying to protect his Diamond...

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: You mean that diamond I found the other day belonged to him? But why didn't he just ask for it back? It's not like I really want it or anything!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: And how did you know we had that diamond anyway, fleshy?

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.player: Your son told me. That's why I rescued you, it is very important that I have that diamond...

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll mother
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Ooohhhhh, my poor baby! He must have been so worried about us...

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Yes, but he certainly inherited his Dad's smarts!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: If he'd told this fleshy that he had the Diamond and not us, we might never have been rescued!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.player: Wait... what? That stupid little troll kid had the diamond all along?

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll mother
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Don't you talk about my baby like that!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Now, now dear, all's well that ends well. We've been freed and this fleshy has certainly earned himself that diamond.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Let's get out of this terrible place and see our son!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: That's right son, and it's all thanks to this brave adventurer here. Now, make sure you hand over that diamond he was looking for.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: It has been nothing but trouble for us, let's just get back to our cave and have dinner.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll mother
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: That's right son, it's your favorite tonight too! A big plate of raw mackerel!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.text: Here ya go! Thanks for getting my mom and dad away from the bad man!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-parents.player: Don't worry about it, just as long as I don't have to go back into that blizzard.

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-father-.speaker: Troll father
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-father-.text: Thanks again for freeing me from that ice block! I might be a troll, but it was real uncomfortable in there!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-mother-.speaker: Troll mother
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-mother-.text: Thanks again for freeing me from that ice block! I don't know what my little snookums would have done without us!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: Thanks for all your help! I'm surprised you managed to survive the blizzard, being a thin skinned fleshy and all!

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.player: What can I say? I'm a lot tougher than I look.
I lost that diamond of Ice you gave me...

ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.speaker: Troll child
ice-diamond-talking-to-the-troll-child-a.text: That's okay, it blew back on an icy wind... It's almost like it wants to stay here! Here, take it back, you've earned it.

the-ancient-pyramid-stranger-danger.speaker: Stranger
the-ancient-pyramid-stranger-danger.text: You are not worthy of holding that Diamond of [Blood/Shadow/Smoke/Ice]!

the-ancient-pyramid-upon-defeating-the-s.player: I wonder what that was all about?

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.player: I have collected one Diamond so far!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: That is a good start... but Azzanadra is still imprisoned!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.player: So can you give me any help on where to find these warriors and their diamonds?
I have collected 2 Diamonds so far!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: That is a good start... but Azzanadra is still imprisoned!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.player: So can you give me any help on where to find these warriors and their diamonds?
I have collected 3 Diamonds so far!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: That is a good start... but Azzanadra is still imprisoned!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.player: So can you give me any help on where to find these warriors and their diamonds?
So I have all four of these Diamonds of Azzanadra, now what?

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: Azzanadra was a Mahjarrat hero. He was unkillable, and the cowardly traitors who stole our lands did not know what to do with him, for his hatred for them was as strong as his magics.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: In the end, they cast a spell upon him, to trap him in the stone structure to the South of here.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: They stole his very life force, the essence of his power, and trapped it within four crystals - the very same Four Diamonds which you have now recovered from the brigands who stole from us.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: The four pillars surrounding the structure are keeping the containment spell intact. By placing a diamond into each, you will breach the magical defences and begin to restore Azzanadra's

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: power, and be able to enter the structure.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: Go, place the diamonds, and free my lord Azzanadra!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: The path will be hard, for his prison is full of traps and danger to prevent his rescue, but he will reward you beyond your wildest dreams when freed!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-eblis-wit.text: Quickly... After all these centuries, Lord Azzanadra is nearly free! You must spare no time, place the Diamonds upon the pillars and enter the pyramid so that you may free him!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.text: Hello again. How's the treasure hunting going?

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.text: What? But you've been gone ages!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.text: C'mon, you can be square with me, you must have found more treasure than just four measly diamonds by now!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.text: Hmmm. Well, okay a deal is a deal. Hand two of them over.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.player: Actually, I think I'm going to need them to gain access to the real treasure...

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.text: Don't worry about two measly diamonds if you think they'll lead to something better!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-asgarnia-.text: I don't usually get out of bed for less than a hundred gold bars!

the-ancient-pyramid-attempting-to-replac.text: You are not a powerful enough mage to breach the protective aura.
You need a magic level of at least 50 to enter the Pyramid.

the-ancient-pyramid-replacing-the-diamon.text: The diamond is absorbed into the pillar...

steps.text: The force preventing access to the Pyramid has now vanished.

the-ancient-pyramid-trying-to-use-the-pa.text: This passage doesn't seem to lead anywhere...

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.player: I used the Four Diamonds on the pillars surrounding the pyramid...

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Ah, that was the power being re-absorbed back into them. That should have been sufficient to break the magic seal preventing anyone exiting or entering the structure.

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Quickly, you must let Lord Azzanadra know that he is free again after these many years!

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Eblis
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Please, when you have freed Azzanadra, let me know what words he has for his faithful followers...

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Hello again, apprentice archaeologist. How's the treasure hunting going?

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Great! Pass me my share, and it's a good job all around!

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Huh? You're not trying to break a deal here are ya???

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.player: No, it's just... There were these weird pillars around this pyramid...
They kind of... ate the diamonds...

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: That's a crazy story kid. Why would you go putting diamonds into them in the first place anyway? Diamonds!

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.player: Well, I have this feeling there is some better treasure inside that pyramid, and I needed to put the diamonds in to gain entrance.

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Well what are you wasting time talking to me for?

the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.speaker: Asgarnia Smith
the-ancient-pyramid-after-replacing-the-.text: Go get me some treasure, pal!

the-ancient-pyramid-praying-at-the-altar.text: This altar seems to do nothing...

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: I knew they could not trap me here for long! Well done, friend. Tell me, how goes the war?

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: You do not know of the war for our survival? More time must have passed than I had thought...

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: Tell me, what news of great Paddewwa? Do the shining spires of Lassar still stand? And what of glorious Annakarl? The fortress is still intact?

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.player: Er... sorry, I've never heard of them...

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: No! My lord... what has become of you? I cannot hear your voice anymore!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: My thanks to you friend for your help in freeing me from this accursed place, but it seems I have much to do to make amends. If our empire no longer stands, it means that we must have failed my lord...

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: How long have I been trapped here? Master... have you truly been dispatched from this world?

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: My friend, for your efforts in freeing me, I offer you the gift of knowledge. We Mahjarrat were once granted powerful ancient magicks by our lord. I now bestow their power upon you.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: They will replace the knowledge you previously had, but you may switch between them by praying at the altar in this room at any time. May you use them well.

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.speaker: Azzanadra
the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.text: I trust that we shall meet again, but now I must leave you. Feel free to use the portal I shall create to return here easily in the future!

the-ancient-pyramid-talking-to-azzanadra.player: I should go and let Eblis know what's happened here...

post-quest-eblis.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis.text: So have you spoken to my Lord Azzanadra yet?

post-quest-eblis.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis.text: And what words did he have for his followers?

post-quest-eblis.player: Er.... He didn't really mention you at all, but he did teach me some cool new magic spells.

post-quest-eblis.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis.text: It is understandable perhaps... His poor mind must be addled after all of those years of confinement, he would not willingly ignore his followers...

post-quest-eblis.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis.text: Anyway, if he has taught you our ancient magics, you may be interested in purchasing an ancient heirloom that was passed down to me. My ancestor fought in the ancient battles using the

post-quest-eblis.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis.text: magic of our god. This heirloom will help you with the speed of your spell-casting.

post-quest-eblis.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis.text: Normally I could not bear to part with such a priceless relic, but for your help in freeing my Lord Azzanadra, I will be prepared to sell it to you for a mere 80,000 gold.

steps.text: If the player has enough gold to purchase it:

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Take care of it, it is the only heirloom from those times I possess, although rumour has it many of our ancient warriors were buried with identical weapons so that they could continue to fight for my Lord in their deaths.
If the player doesn't have enough gold to purchase it:

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Stranger... Do not abuse my generosity... I cannot possibly sell it for less than 80,000 gold.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: Come back and see me when you have the necessary funds to buy.

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.speaker: Eblis
steps.text: As you wish. Bear my offer in mind should you ever change your decision, I will remain here.

options.text: Have you got any symbols of your god?

steps.player: I'll leave you to it.

options.text: Have you got any symbols of your god?

steps.player: Have you got any symbols of your god?

steps.text: Eblis gives you a little signet. Its shape matches the icon you saw on the altar in the pyramid.

post-quest-eblis-after-buying-his-staff.speaker: Eblis
post-quest-eblis-after-buying-his-staff.text: Greetings. I await the return of my Lord Azzanadra and of our god. I do not know why, but I feel this spot has some significance...
